description:
An integrator alone does not make a transient simulator. Transient behaviour comes from state that accumulates: mass, energy and momentum holdup inside vessels, drums, columns and pipes.

SCOPE: add inventory state to the unit operations that need it — separator and vessel liquid level, column stage holdup, pipe line-pack, heat-exchanger metal thermal mass — and integrate those states rather than solving them algebraically. Steady state must fall out as the zero-derivative limit, which is a directly testable property.

TEST THIS PROPERTY EXPLICITLY: a transient run started from the converged steady state and held at constant boundary conditions must stay at that state. Any drift is a conservation bug in the integrator or the holdup terms.

Depends on the flowsheet data model and the integrator.
title: refinery: dynamic unit-operation holdup and inventory — what actually makes it transient

description: v2 duplicates ~3000 lines of v1's physics (full_simulation/mod.rs 2085, heat_transfer_solvers.rs 683, fluid_solvers.rs 237, diagnostics.rs 52) because those live in a tuas EXAMPLE directory and cannot be imported across crates. Proper fix: promote educational_ciet_loop_version_4 + its three helper modules into the tuas library under pre_built_components/ciet_three_branch_plus_dracs/ciet_educational_simulator_loop_prototypes/version_4/, parameterised over a state type, then have BOTH v1 and v2 call it. Deferred deliberately: doing it now would mean refactoring v1, which was out of scope for the v2 request. Blocked on the port-equivalence check landing first, so there is a regression gate before the de-dup.
title: De-duplicate CIET loop: promote v4 solver into the tuas library

description: For every member crate, confirm the non-GUI library (and non-GUI tests) build for aarch64-linux-android; find any other Android-hostile deps beyond ndarray-linalg (C-linking crates, hdf5 native, BLAS, etc.) and target-gate them. Needs the Android target + NDK / cargo-ndk on the host. njoy is 'lean' (thiserror/uom, no BLAS) so should be close; check hdf5-pure (pure-Rust, likely OK) and miniz_oxide (pure-Rust, OK).
title: Per-crate Android build audit (cargo check --target aarch64-linux-android)
